title: Can the same full pair table hide a junction while a triple is legal after a binary three-output addition?
claim: Freeze the expected sharp triple cutoff and the coexistence prediction before measuring. Settle live junction ambiguity for the binary third three-output family by a uniform proof or a least reachable pair, compare the menus and any needed extra readings, and determine whether the exact width-28 pair from K can be separated by a continuation.
standard_statement: For the binary-third source family, all clipped bond-distance isometries through four into any mixed rival preserve every marked triple permission and, if any mark is legal, all physical junction supports. Four is necessary. The mathematical theorem refutes the positive coexistence prediction.
prior_work: The third ternary-output addition with three parents was settled by K. The binary third-output case has more loose distinctions and maximum ordinary support five.
completion_gate: Prove live-support rigidity or certify a least reachable live collision, explicitly compare the menus, address any extra reading if needed, decide the exact width-28 pair under appropriate continuations, and score the sharp cutoff in its proper scope.
source_contribution: Histories certify reachability and grade supports and permissions. The reader sees no history.

validation.status: V1. Separate same-task structural proof audits and exact frontier/census checks. Six executable records replayed byte for byte under a new hash seed. Direct full-table pair computations, literal histories, suffix shore enumerations and the frozen predictions were checked. Separate referee review pending.

conclusion: Four is the sharp all-size cutoff for every present three-parent permission. Whenever one triple is permitted, the same clipped table identification fixes every actual junction support. The prediction of live hidden junctions is refuted in this family. At 32 distinctions two physical supports can differ with equal states and empty menus.
evidence_class: All-size structural theorem with an exact finite frontier and explicit reachable witnesses.
target_disposition: Sharp cutoff prediction proved. Positive coexistence prediction refuted. The exact K pair has a separating common continuation and isomorphic anonymous futures.
unrestricted_obligation: Triple-permission invariance remains open for unrestricted serial mixed growth. At exactly three three-output additions and a unique ternary seed, only the unary third addition remains a possible source of an opposing triple. Entire equation-space recovery along every four-loose binary suffix in this study is also open.
failure_conditions: A marked clipped isometry through four changing a verdict with a source in scope, or moving an ordinary junction while any triple is legal.
A reachable binary-third frontier missing from the closed transitions, a positive binary predecessor at five loose, or a fourth-shrink shore outside the structural classification.
